svg.title: Attention performance across twelve GPU targets
svg.desc: The named reference backend time divided by selected CuTe time. Each cell uses a same-process comparison from its retained study. Current training, NoGrad forward, historical and experimental results have separate sections. Tables show only measured dimension/phase columns, grouping rows by coverage. Values are graph replay, not eager or model speedups.
svg.text: Attention performance · named reference time / CuTe time
Above 1×: CuTe faster (teal) · below 1×: reference faster (brown) · tables show retained measurements only
F = training forward · F+B = forward + all gradients · I = NoGrad forward · BF/FP = BF16/FP16 · D/C = dense/causal
Warmed CUDA-event graph replay, milliseconds per call; compilation excluded. Hover cells for timings and study/run provenance.
Dimensions and phase columns follow each table’s measured coverage; omitted combinations have no retained comparison.

Missing current timing evidence: A100/A40 D512; RTX 3090 D256/D512; several synthetic NoGrad grids. These gaps need fresh GPU measurements.
